sheet.source: Extracted from autodetailinglondon.co.uk on 15 November 2026 (6 pages, desktop). Fonts, colours, radii and component styles are theirs unless marked derived.
decisions: Button text is dark (#262626) on their gold. The site uses white on gold, about 2.3:1, which fails WCAG AA. Dark text reads at about 7:1.
Gold used as text on the light page is darkened to #8A6510 (accent-text). Their #D9A520 on #F9F8F6 is about 2.1:1 and fails. Gold stays as-is for fills, and as text on the dark #333 band.
Dark band is their footer and surface colour #333333. Tint band is their muted colour (#EFEDE8). Neither is invented.
Buttons are pills in sentence case, as on their site. Weight raised from 500 to 600 for clarity at small sizes. Revert if the client prefers.
Fields use their 12px radius, not the pill search box, because labelled forms with selects and text areas read badly as pills.
Cards keep their look: white, 1px #DDDAD5 border, 16px corners, no shadow.
Photos: the before/after pair and the Rolls-Royce come from their site; confirm they are their own work and that customers agreed. The Ferrari photo shows another valeter's decal and is not used.
Every price except 'Deluxe interior from £195' is TBC. Quotes keep the placeholder flag until a full name or town and written permission arrive.
